svg.title: Questions and reflection prompts
svg.desc: Which part of a person's thinking is elicited? The object of the prompt distinguishes needs, an account of reasoning, inquiry about the material, and reflection on one's own thinking. Source illustration: A guided form elicits design context before the system customizes research cards.

text.tspan: Which part of a person's thinking is elicited?
Asks people to express their goals, questions, explanations or
reflections, making their own reasoning available to the work.
Recorded form · FC060: Reflection or self-assessment prompt (VA056).

a.aria-label: Inspect recorded mechanism: MindShift: Leveraging Large Language Models for Mental-States-Based Problematic Smartphone Use Intervention
